## v0.3.0

This release turns the fork into a publishable, configurable Smart Title plugin for OpenCode.

### Added
- `titleFormat` support with placeholders like `{title}`, `{cwd}`, `{cwdTip}`, `{cwdTip:N}`, and `{cwdTip:git}`
- Custom `prompt` support for controlling title language and style
- `excludeDirectories` support to skip noisy/background directories
- Stronger config parsing and merge behavior for safer overrides

### Improved
- Better model selection diagnostics with structured error logging
- Timing information for model selection and provider discovery
- Richer provider logging for debugging fallback behavior
- README rewritten for install, configuration, and publishing flow

### Packaging
- Published as `@frankhommers/opencode-smart-title`
- Updated AI SDK dependencies for current compatibility
